definitions.explanation: The remains or traces of an ancient civilization, building, or settlement. Archaeological sites from the past.

examples.japanese: {遺跡|いせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{訪|おとず}れる。
{遺跡|いせき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{銅貨|どうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発掘|はっくつ}された→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧。
examples.english: Copper coins were excavated from the ruins.

examples.japanese: {古代|こだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺跡|いせき}。

notes:
{遺跡|いせき} refers to the physical remains of past civilizations or historical sites — ruins, archaeological sites, and ancient settlements. Composed of {遺|い} (leave behind) + {跡|せき} (trace/remains).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {遺跡|いせき}を{発掘|はっくつ}する: to excavate ruins
- {遺跡|いせき}を{調査|ちょうさ}する: to survey/investigate ruins
- {古代|こだい}{遺跡|いせき}: ancient ruins
- {世界|せかい}{遺産|いさん}の{遺跡|いせき}: World Heritage ruins

FAMOUS EXAMPLES:
- {三内丸山|さんないまるやま}{遺跡|いせき}: Sannai-Maruyama site (Jomon period)
- {吉野ヶ里|よしのがり}{遺跡|いせき}: Yoshinogari ruins (Yayoi period)

RELATED TERMS:
- {史跡|しせき}: officially designated historic site
- {遺物|いぶつ}: artifact, relic
- {発掘|はっくつ}: excavation
- {考古学|こうこがく}: archaeology
